"A user-agent line starts a new group unless the previous record was also a user-agent line (blank, comment and ignored lines between them do not count), in which case it adds a name to the current group. The check's userAgent matches a group when it equals one of the group's names compared ASCII case-insensitively. The rules of every matching group are combined. If no group matches, the rules of every group named * are combined. If there is none, no rules apply and every URL is allowed."
